rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial verb for paying out or spending money.

example.english: I often spend money on sneakers.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 sai2 cin2 maai5 bo1 haai4

rows.note: Use this for spending or devoting time to an activity rather than spending money.

example.jyutping: ngo5 faa1 si4 gaan3 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2
